A Personal Touch
Nov 2019 • Family

Highly recommend this restaurant, worth your stay.

Slow Service and Average Food
Aug 2019
When we arrived at Orientica the restaurant was completely empty except for the employees - this was a bad sign. Service - even though the restaurant was empty - was slow. Food was very average - I would categorize it as Chinese International in style. I ordered a bottle of wine from the ipad wine list - 30 minutes later the waiter reurned to tell me they did not have the bottle I ordered. I wonder why it takes 30 minutes to figure out they do not have that wine? The room is nice: upscale Chinese.
